deploymentReadiness.statement: Dominion OS is ready for governed deployment into the client cloud estate. Public reference runtimes are optional demonstration surfaces.

portabilityContract.publicPrivateBoundary: public proof surfaces are separated from client data, keys, payment systems, private APIs, signed services, and private source
portabilityContract.releaseControl: provider implementations use governed build, validation, deployment, and receipt controls
portabilityContract.clientControl: identity, network, data, keys, region, policy, and operating controls remain scoped to the client estate

providers.name: Google Cloud
providers.publicStatus: Ready for Google Cloud deployment through the containerized Cloud Run release path.
providers.publicMessage: Automated build, Cloud Run release automation, health and status contracts, and governed receipts are prepared for client implementation.
providers.claim: Deployment-ready Google Cloud path with an optional public reference runtime

lastExternalReview.interpretation: The optional public reference runtime was not published at review time. This does not alter client deployment readiness.

providers.name: Microsoft Azure
providers.publicStatus: Ready for Azure deployment with dedicated infrastructure, validation, compliance, and CI/CD assets.
providers.publicMessage: Provisioned to the client subscription, Entra identity, network, security, data-residency, and operating requirements.
providers.claim: Dedicated Azure infrastructure and validation path ready for client implementation

providers.name: Amazon Web Services
providers.publicStatus: Ready for AWS deployment with dedicated infrastructure, validation, compliance, and CI/CD assets.
providers.publicMessage: Provisioned to the client account, IAM boundary, VPC, region, data, security, and operating requirements.
providers.claim: Dedicated AWS infrastructure and validation path ready for client implementation

providers.name: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure
providers.publicStatus: Ready for Oracle Cloud Infrastructure through the portable container runtime and client-specific provisioning plan.
providers.publicMessage: Provisioned against the client tenancy, identity, network, data-residency, security, and operating requirements.
providers.claim: Portable OCI deployment path ready for client-specific provisioning

evidence.providerSpecificProvisioning: generated against the client OCI tenancy and controls

claimControl.reason: Dominion OS is ready for governed deployment across Google Cloud, Azure, AWS, and OCI. Deployment readiness is distinct from continuous public demo availability and from provider marketplace publication.
